quests.title: The Licensed Lot
quests.premise: A salvage lot on the bench is recognised by the family from whom it was lifted, though the diving licence behind it is genuine

quests.title: The Second Room
quests.premise: A diver's lamp came back up the shaft on its line without her

quests.title: Reading the Stones
quests.premise: A council clerk is paid by the season to keep the memorial's names weathered past reading

quests.title: Tolls on the Swept Circle
quests.premise: A Blackguards cell charges the hist-less households to walk the street they built

quests.title: The Record Room
quests.premise: Two centuries of unread customs books would settle a dozen living property claims, so somebody is inserting pages ahead of the clerk who is finally reading them

quests.title: Offerings in the Mouth
quests.premise: The fishers' offering season is blocked by a council order to bring the drowned god ashore

quests.title: The Barge Debt
quests.premise: A councillor's losses at the dice tables are being called in as a civic matter

quests.title: Licensing the Lighters
quests.premise: The council wants the lighter crews licensed, the crews want the tariff opened, each side wants you to carry the offer

quests.title: Escort and Tribute
quests.premise: The road escorts for which Lilmoth pays have started splitting the Naga toll rather than breaking it

quests.title: Short of Divers
quests.premise: The lime cutters have lost three free-divers in a season to something living in the worked steps

quests.title: The Retired Rota
quests.premise: Cheydinhal has sent a claimant for an intake that the retired Shadowscales cannot agree how to award

quests.title: Rice and Rust
quests.premise: Lilmoth's rice is landing tainted from somewhere along the estate's flood channel

quests.title: Down to the Hold
quests.premise: Four families have agreed to fund a single cut into the Alessian hull's shut hold, on condition somebody watches the others

quests.title: What the Reef Is Saying
quests.premise: The dying reef head has begun sounding at the turn of the tide, so the bay pilots have started steering by it

quests.title: Fish in the House Floors
quests.premise: At each spring tide the drowned hamlet's dead come up through the roofs and go back to their own doors

quests.title: A Body in the Lot
quests.premise: A corpse surfaces inside a sorted salvage lot, weighted with the yard's own licence tags

quests.title: The Half-Day Detour
quests.premise: The last carter to cut through Ganthil's Rest rather than take the half-day detour has not come out

quests.title: The Keeper's Weather
quests.premise: The council wants a dry harvest fortnight from a calendar keeper who has refused emperors' agents

quests.title: Three Failing Spans
quests.premise: The junction deck carries more traffic than its timbers can bear, with its households split over who pays to cut new ones

quests.title: Whoever Relights It
quests.premise: Relighting the dead Topal lantern would decide who profits from the bar, so three parties are each proving the stair unsafe

quests.title: The Untouched House
quests.premise: A Lilmoth broker is selling deeds to plague-emptied Rockpark houses that no buyer has yet dared enter

quests.title: The Silt Room
quests.premise: A survey party has gone into the xanmeer pumped dry by the An-Xileel, to see how far the returning silt has taken it

quests.title: Cargo Off the Ledger
quests.premise: Cargo lightered ashore at night is being settled at the dice tables instead of the quay

quests.title: The Sixth Recitation
quests.premise: The six-day recitation needs six speakers, of whom two now work Lilmoth's quay

quests.title: Grave-Poles for the City
quests.premise: Lilmoth wants its own burial register kept in the city; Xul-Vaat's grave-wrights hold that the register is the trade

quests.title: What Came Up Belongs
quests.premise: A drowned villa is stripped clean before its living heirs can lodge a claim, on a route which the yard had not licensed

quests.title: The Beast Ground Ledger
quests.premise: Escort contracts are being written for journeys never made by the convoys, over the Naga camp's own signatures

quests.title: Air on the Slate
quests.premise: The slate at Breathing-Stone lists a diver who went below eleven days ago, in a hand that the reef cutters do not recognise

quests.title: The Ball and the Ledger
quests.premise: Lilmoth wants a side in the Teeba-Enoo court to prove its writ reaches Meerhleel's quay

quests.title: The Hollow Under the Wall
quests.premise: The root gallery floods to chest height on a week's notice, with somebody living in it who will not come out

quests.title: Sees-No-Root's Egg
quests.premise: A mnemic egg lost with a village's tree is rumoured to be in a root gallery two rivers away

quests.title: Licences for a Burnt Hinterland
quests.premise: Soulrest's surviving provincial offices are still issuing licences for a hinterland that burned two centuries ago

quests.title: Three Claims on a Harbour
quests.premise: Three parties hold defensible title to the same deep-water landfall, with the tariff argument now out of the Long Table and into the street

quests.title: Books of the Bench
quests.premise: The harbour office wants the salvage yard's books, in which every lot is somebody's lost cargo

quests.title: The Last Imperial Hull
quests.premise: The supply of Legion transports is finished, so the breaking yard must decide what it is for next

quests.title: The False Light
quests.premise: A century of wrecks on the Long Bar could be proved deliberate, which would force the harbour office to act

quests.title: Licensed and Disowned
quests.premise: Soulrest licenses the anchorage in one ledger while denying it in another, which a Khajiit master wants settled in writing

quests.title: Whatever the Sea Lost
quests.premise: Goods from a wreck are on sale at Chasepoint before their owners know the ship is down

quests.title: The Price the Legion Set
quests.premise: The Fourth Stage still charges an Imperial rate for its well, which the road's carters have stopped paying

quests.title: Hired to Go Upriver
quests.premise: The ferry family are hired upriver far more often than the traffic explains, though their last party has not returned

quests.title: Four Parties, One Sill
quests.premise: One of the four parties contesting the gravel sill has begun moving stone in the channel at night

quests.title: Sell Early and Low
quests.premise: Mudfoot has found a way to prove that Soulrest's cockle price is set before the boats land

quests.title: Owed Labour on the Sea Wall
quests.premise: The salt walls are rebuilt each spring by people working off an Owing that does not fall

quests.title: A Pack Under the Threshing Floor
quests.premise: The abandoned plantation is still roofed and still worth salvaging, with something denned beneath its floor

quests.title: The Gate Warning
quests.premise: Ashroot warns at its gate that the burn-country jungle kills people who walk it alone, which is where a Soulrest survey went

quests.title: Five Centuries of Stock
quests.premise: The first crew into the plague town's five centuries of untouched stock came back changed

quests.title: Four Miles Away
quests.premise: A Colovian heir has arrived with the deed to a great house the neighbouring families burned

quests.title: The Cordon Cellars
quests.premise: The prison's cordon cellars were sealed with their occupants still on the roll

quests.title: Ninety Minutes of Tide
quests.premise: Somebody has begun marking the channel mouth that is navigable for ninety minutes at the top of the tide

quests.title: Pilots or Customs
quests.premise: Blackguards want Bramman's river opened as a road, Soulrest wants it declared a customs matter, the pilots want it forgotten

quests.title: The Taking Rules
quests.premise: A licensed buyer has offered to break the egg-takers' rules at a scale beyond any Soulrest law

quests.title: Buying the Unmaking
quests.premise: A collector has paid for this year's clay wraxu before the Clutch can destroy it

quests.title: Whose Lot Is Whose
quests.premise: The breaking yard has started buying Long Bar wrecks without asking, in ironwork recognised by the divers' yard

quests.title: Contracted at the Long Table
quests.premise: A crew hired in the least private room in the port sails and is not seen again, with every witness remembering a different master

quests.title: The Salt Year
quests.premise: A wet-season overtop has spoiled the salt pans and the cockle flat together, each side blaming the other's works

quests.title: The Sunken Causeway Survey
quests.premise: A road survey east of Soulrest went out to price a causeway repair and stopped sending its stages back

quests.title: The Stage That Was Not Paid
quests.premise: Two families each claim to be the Legion's unpaid stage-keeper, with two centuries of arrears behind the claim

quests.title: Silt from the Burn Country
quests.premise: River silt is turning the living reef head to rubble, which makes the bar deadlier every season

quests.title: The Anchorage Ledger
quests.premise: Cargo landed at Quin'rawl is entered at the Long Table as having come by road

quests.title: A Grave for a Foreigner
quests.premise: A Soulrest merchant's will asks for a Xul-Vaat pole, over the objections of both the register and his heirs

quests.title: The Ration Argument Breaks Down
quests.premise: The villages ration the glowing harvest by an argument that has finally broken down

quests.title: What the Salvage Coast Owes
quests.premise: Survivors pulled off the bar have been kept as salvage crew to work their own rescue off

quests.title: The Weather Petition
quests.premise: Soulrest's council has begun buying the keeper's succession rather than asking her for weather

quests.title: A Side in the Court
quests.premise: The port's Teeba-Enoo side is short two players, though a convincing win would be a diplomatic problem

quests.title: Robbed on Meerhleel's Quay
quests.premise: Meerhleel's whole advantage is that it asks no questions, so a merchant robbed on its quay has nowhere to complain

quests.title: The Raft Quarter Rent
quests.premise: The warehouse row has begun charging the Argonian raft quarter for the water beneath its rafts

quests.title: Sugar Moved North
quests.premise: Moon-sugar that used to land untaxed at Moonmarch now arrives here, where Lilmoth's council has noticed it

quests.title: The Gazetteer's One Name
quests.premise: An Imperial gazetteer clerk is being paid to strike the province's single Khajiiti place-name from the next edition

quests.title: Poling Water
quests.premise: A cargo must go above the last supplied bed on the Keel-Sakka, on a reach that the polers have refused

quests.title: Lights Under the Pilgrim Road
quests.premise: The fen has begun lighting in a pattern legible to the night pilgrims, which each village reads differently

quests.title: Digging at the Far End
quests.premise: Something has been working at the far terrace of the dry crown on which four villages bury

quests.title: No Village Will Yield an Inch
quests.premise: The burial crown is out of terrace, with each of its four sectors preferring to bury badly rather than give ground

quests.title: Who Stocked the Bench
quests.premise: The air chamber's bench was stocked by somebody for thirty years, until this season

quests.title: The Last Hist Before the Burn
quests.premise: Ashroot shelters whoever reaches it, though its sheltering rite has begun to fail on the burn-country side

quests.title: Walked It Alone
quests.premise: Three people from the plantation ignored Ashroot's gate warning in one season

quests.title: Tapped Past Bearing
quests.premise: Ashroot's tree is being drawn on harder each year to shelter refugees from the burn country

quests.title: Six Days, Four Speakers
quests.premise: Sees-No-Root's recitation needs six speakers and the village can field four

quests.title: The Pulled Field
quests.premise: Somebody pulled the grave-poles out of the burial field, leaving no way to match a pole to its grave

quests.title: Rice and Tenancy
quests.premise: Lilmoth depends on Hereguard rice, which gives the tenants a hold now felt by the Breton family

quests.title: Hired From Outside
quests.premise: The estate pays outsiders in coin and its tenants in credit, in books that do not add up

quests.title: The Early Flood Channel
quests.premise: The estate's oldest flood channel fills a fortnight before the river does, for reasons that the Breton steward cannot name

quests.title: Where the Writ Stops
quests.premise: Bright-Throat's chime-relay reaches the landing where Lilmoth's writ does not, which a cargo is using

quests.title: The Poler's Rate
quests.premise: The polers have set one rate for the whole river, which the landing's boat-owners will not honour

quests.title: Above the Supplied Bed
quests.premise: Something denned in the outer root galleries upriver has started coming down to the landing

quests.title: Cockles Before Dawn
quests.premise: The village's early boats are being emptied on the flat before they reach the Soulrest buyers

quests.title: A Dry Floor, No Questions
quests.premise: The cheapest bed on Topal Bay takes whoever pays, including whoever left a body under its boards

quests.title: The Register in Duplicate
quests.premise: Xul-Vaat keeps its burial register twice over, in two copies that have begun to disagree about who is buried

quests.title: Branching Round the Gaps
quests.premise: Walks-The-Mangrove is branching new walkway around its failing spans, while the households left behind want their sections rebuilt

quests.title: Two Miles of Deck
quests.premise: Something uses the dry way through the mangrove after dark, so the village walks it in daylight only

quests.title: The Broker's Price
quests.premise: The price of Bright-Throat's last endorsement was a household's labour, owed to a creditor outside the village
